title: VPORT shade-plot field retention fast slice
scope: retain VPORT DXF group 170 and group 333 independently from VIEWPORT fields
limit writes to conservative modes 0-3 with null target and AC1021+
fail closed on unqualified non-null target or modern shade mode

primary_sources.observation: The VPORT DXF table defines group 170 as shade-plot setting and group 333 as optional soft-pointer shade-plot object ID/handle; it does not list mode values or a first-supported release.
PlotSettings shade enum members are 0-5; modes 4 and 5 name VisualStyle and RenderPreset. This does not independently qualify the VPORT DXF release/producer contract.
PlotSettings SetShadePlot requires VisualStyle/RenderSettings for modes 4/5 and ignores/nulls the ID for modes 0/3. This API evidence is not a VPORT graph or producer witness.

implementation.behavior: DRW_Vport now retains group 170 mode and group 333 handle with separate presence flags. DXF output permits only modes 0-3 and a null target, refuses modern modes and non-null target without graph closure, and applies a conservative AC1021 output floor. DWG parse/encode was not changed.
generated_ascii_binary_controls: absent shade fields remain absent after round-trip
AC1018 target fails atomically when shade fields are present
